name: With Reckless Abandon
source:
Malthus is having trouble at her bank job. If she messes up one more client, she's out.

Her next one will ask the world of her, and Malthus will bend over backwards to deliver.

[From [url=https://howling-angel-games.itch.io/with-reckless-abandon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
马尔萨斯的银行工作遇到了麻烦。如果她再惹恼一位客户，她就出局了。

她的下一个任务将询问她的世界，而马尔萨斯将竭尽全力来实现这一目标。

[来自[url=https://howling-angel-games.itch.io/with-reckless-abandon]itch.io[/url]]
